nodes.label: Advanced Molecular Docking Protocol
nodes.rationale: Automates an end-to-end deterministic virtual-screening workflow from receptor structures and ligand SDF files through validated docking and reporting.

nodes.label: Deterministic Active-Site Selection
nodes.rationale: Parses HETATM records in pure Python and requires user confirmation so pocket selection is reproducible and needs no AI or API key.

nodes.label: Validation Redocking
nodes.rationale: Re-docks the native ligand and measures RMSD against its crystal pose to validate pocket centering before production docking.

nodes.label: Redocking RMSD Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Classifies RMSD at or below 2 Å as PASS, 2–3 Å as MARGINAL, and above 3 Å as FAIL to communicate docking-pocket reliability.

nodes.label: Commercial License
nodes.rationale: Commercial use that does not comply with AGPL v3 requires a separate license, while external-tool licenses remain the licensee's responsibility.

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Transforms mixed corpora into a persistent knowledge graph with provenance-aware extraction, clustering, reports, JSON, and interactive visualization.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only integrity gate exposes dangling or missing endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed edges without aborting graph generation.

nodes.label: Provenance Confidence Model
nodes.rationale: Relationships are explicitly classified as EXTRACTED, INFERRED, or AMBIGUOUS and scored under a fixed rubric to preserve an honest audit trail.

nodes.label: Incremental Graph Update
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new or changed files, prunes deleted sources, and preserves existing graph content to reduce time and semantic-extraction cost.
